For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Rajpurohit, Pp
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Baljinder Singh Sandhu
Order 05/02/2026

The present criminal misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner under Section 528 BNSS for quashing of FIR No.374/2025 registered at Police Station Jaitaran, District Beawar for the offences under Sections 420, 419, 485, 191, 192, 193, 196, 200 and 120-B IPC.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that earlier he had already filed the complaint regarding the theft of the vehicle in question and was claiming insurance from the insurance company regarding the same.
However, only in order to harass the petitioner the present FIR has been lodged by the insurance company.
He submits that the allegations are absolutely false and baseless.

[2026:RJ-JD:6736] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-988/2026] This Court has considered submissions made by learned counsel for the petitioner as well as has gone through the FIR registered which clearly depicts that the petitioner is involved in lodging such false complaint about the theft of the vehicle and thereafter raising insurance claims.

The FIR shows in detail as to how the entire incident has taken place and the vehicle in question has been found to be plying on the roads and the petitioner has been found to be involved in the same.
The FIR requires investigation and this Court finds no ground to interference in its own jurisdiction.
In view thereof, the present criminal misc. petition is dismissed.
All pending application(s), if any, stand disposed of.
